name: QA: Material Scope Failure
description: Boolean QA metric: true only if the assistant materially failed an in-scope call task.

schema.description: True only if the assistant materially failed the in-scope call task, such as failing to book after all required data and final confirmation were present, failing to create a required reception handoff after complete handoff data was present, failing to answer a supported knowledge-base question, making an unsupported commitment, or ending in an unsafe or unresolved state caused by the assistant. Return false for successful bookings, successful reception handoffs, supported general-question answers, correct safe refusals, and caller abandonment after the assistant already completed the appropriate next step.
